text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: metering-heartbeat-slowroll detected in us-west-2. Missing heartbeat > 5m from emitter pool. Severity P2. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/metering-heartbeat

sam_oncall: Oncall Sam here, taking ownership. Seeing customer overage flags and delayed usage reports reported by billing. Starting triage.

lee (SRE): I can see a slow downstream consumer on the Kafka topic 'metering-emits-v2' — consumer lag jumped ~1.2M msgs at 16:02 UTC. Exec query: `select max(lag) from consumer_lag where topic='metering-emits-v2'` -> 1.2M.

maya_billing: Billing dashboard: anomalous token bump +18% in the last 30m for multiple accounts. Overage email batch queued (not yet sent). If consumer lag persists, we'll keep overshooting invoiced totals.

jordan_support: We already have 3 customer replies in support inbox asking why they got overage flags. Tagging cs-team.

sam_oncall: Immediate plan: (1) pause overage-alert rule in billing (maya, can you pause?) (2) restart emitter consumer group to catch up (lee doing), (3) prepare compensation/credits list if counts replay wrong (jordan to coordinate CS).

maya_billing: Paused overage-alert rule for the flagged cohort. Stopping outbound emails for now.

lee (SRE): Running safe restart on consumer group: `kafka-consumer-reset --group metering-emitter-group --reset-to-latest --dry-run=false` 
Output snippet: ```
INFO: initiating rebalance
INFO: caught up partitions: 0/12
WARN: backlog present, enabling controlled drain
```

ops-bot: Deploy job emitter-consumer@v2.3.9 started by lee (SRE). CI link: https://ci/repo/build/4821

lee (SRE): Restart completed at 16:08 UTC. Consumer lag reduced to ~180k. Triggering backfill worker to replay missed window. Command: `backfill-tool --topic metering-emits-v2 --from 2026-03-17T15:45Z --to now --rate 2000/s`

sam_oncall: Good. Monitor token deltas while backfill runs. Maya, is billing ingestion idempotent for replayed events?

maya_billing: Yes, ingestion dedup key is `emit_id` + `source_ts`. Backfill should not double-count if the original event was already applied — but if an earlier partial write failed, there is a small risk. I'll watch reconciler metrics: `reconciler.dedup_rate` and `reconciler/error_rate`.

jordan_support: CS is drafting an outbound: hold notification to customers who got emails, brief on potential overcount and that we're pausing alerts and reviewing usage. I'll attach list of impacted accounts to the triage doc.

lee (SRE): Backfill progressing. Current ingestion throughput ~1.8k/s, estimated catch-up time ~12m. Consumer lag trending down steadily.

sam_oncall: Update: billing spike has plateaued and now trending back to expected baseline as backfill completes. We're keeping overage alerts paused for another 30m to validate.

maya_billing: Reconciler shows dedup_rate ~99.98% and no new anomalies in token delta distribution. Temporary overcount window appears covered by replay dedupe. Will hold final judgement pending full reconciliation.

ops-bot: Incident timeline marker created by sam_oncall: `incident/1768555555/triage`

sam_oncall: Immediate mitigation done. Owners: lee (SRE) — follow up on consumer health and autoscaling; maya_billing — run full reconciliation and recommend credits if net billed > actual; jordan_support — communicate to customers. I'll hand this to postmortem queue and assign follow-ups.

jordan_support: Noted. CS will prepare templated credits + timeline once maya confirms final numbers.

sam_oncall: Closing live bridge in 20m if metrics hold. Postmortem: link will be created and assigned to eng-metrics and billing teams. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
